object: Queen's name in a cartouche before her face, in a sculptured and painted relief (queen enthroned, Isis behind her), N.E. wall
site: Gebel Barkal, pyramid 15 (Lepsius), chapel (shrine) on the north-east wall
notes: Printed in Meroitic HIEROGLYPHIC type, not cursive: read right to left with the hieroglyphic column of Griffith's alphabet table (p. xv, leaf n18), outside the tested cursive key. Griffith: 'The [nb] N[-]zamak'; the copy is from a Lepsius squeeze, completed from L., D.; the hatched sign is lost; {nb} is the Egyptian sign outside the cartouche, 'probably for Lord of the Two Lands'; the cartouche might be filled by one large sign, and the spot ':' must mark a division in the name. The label of 77 b over the priest is in the 0078 row (Griffith prints 77 b and 78 as one composite text).
